title: Create Credit Term stays disabled until name and number are valid
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Net 9" in Name.
  3. Type 9 in the Days box.
  4. Clear the Name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • "Create Credit Term" is still disabled (no number yet).

Step 3:

  • "Create Credit Term" becomes enabled.

Step 4:

  • "Create Credit Term" is disabled again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R6: “"Create Credit Term" / "Save Changes" stays disabled until the Name and the chosen box are both valid.”
